text: The latest stable version of livewire/livewire is **v4.4.7**, which was released on **September 28, 2026, at 18:37 UTC** [1][2]. This version is part of the Livewire v4 series, recognized as the current stable major release that continues to be actively developed and is the default frontend stack in Laravel's starter kits [3].
